title: hoshidicts el test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Modern Greek dictionary for languages/el/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. Its nouns and adjectives carry the part-of-speech tags n and adj, which wty-el-en leaves out (README, Known gaps); its function words have none, and three form-of rows are written as wiktionary-to-yomitan writes them.
